_comment: apps/api. Every issue in this project is a genuine fault by construction:
middleware/error.ts reports only what isFault() accepts, which excludes
every 4xx ApiError - a wrong password, a taken address, a route that does
not exist. So this rule does not need filters to be quiet. It is quiet
because the thing feeding it already is.
project is the numeric id from MONITORING_DSN's path, not a slug. Slugs
get renamed; the id in the DSN is the same id this endpoint takes.
